rust_summary: a server player let fly in any game mode and set flying (`native_set_flight`), as Bukkit's `Player.setAllowFlight` and `setFlying`.
doc_summary: `native_set_flight(uuid, allow, flying)` lets a server player fly in any game mode or not, and sets whether they fly now, until their game mode changes, they respawn or leave. Bundles need "hooks": @API:set_flight@.
